title: She Walks
warm:
She walked—Crownspire lobby cameras catching [player_name] leave Detective Imani Brooks's circle and Nolan Greer's reach in one motion that looked like innocence and felt like flight. Soft alibi discarded mid-sentence. Early thirties, across the hall geography suddenly miles, Vivienne's four fates still open, homicide interest rising without a body. Marcus Pell swore softly. Rhea Quinn watched the slate as if walking could be logged.

Nolan would have to chase both the silence and her. Cufflinks behind her clicked once—she heard it without turning. Brutal charm could not hold a woman who spent soft as sidewalk wind.

Choice waited outside glass: elevator-bank reunion if he caught her, or the gap in her story if chase became interrogation of what she still would not name. Black car idle. Wind sheer. Hope and dread on pavement. Layer 6 walk made every later verb cost more.

Walking was the softest violence she had left. Cameras loved innocence; Brooks loved flight narratives; Nolan loved control he had just lost twelve steps at a time. [player_name] did not run. She walked until Crownspire lobby became sidewalk and soft alibi became wind under her clothes.

He would chase silence and her—both. That was the point. Vivienne's contested fate did not get simpler because a mistress left a circle. Four doors stayed open. No body appeared to punish or absolve anyone.

Outside, choice waited: let chase become elevator-bank reunion, or keep the unnamed gap as the only prize chase would win. Black car idle like a question. Elevator bank glowing behind glass. Hope and dread on pavement that did not care about cufflinks.

Soft alibi had legs. Tonight they spent her out of the story until he earned the next verb.
hot:

Every step was mid-want denial. Body screaming toward the man behind her; feet spending soft anyway. Soft alibi eroticism of walking away stayed intimacy-forward—ache, wind, unfinished climax as discipline. She could aim reunion heat—or keep the gap—while cunt still voted Nolan with every stride.

Romance locked. Four fates open. Brooks watching. Crime plot. Unfinished sidewalk ending on purpose because chase had to hurt him into honesty.
